query:
UPDATE projects 
SET 
  excerpt = 'Fan-powered live music experience. 6,800 fans. One unforgettable night. Real-time setlist control.',
  description = 'Red Bull Jukebox transformed Nashville into an interactive music playground. Fans voted. Artists performed. We built the stage that made it possible.',
  designNotes = 'THE CHALLENGE

Red Bull needed a stage that could handle real-time fan interaction, massive LED displays, and a rotating lineup of country music stars—all in one night at Ascend Amphitheater.

THE SOLUTION

Working with Lumenati, we translated bold creative concepts into fabrication-ready reality:

→ Monumental LED arch spanning the full stage width
→ Layered façade components for depth and visual impact  
→ Precision CNC drawings for steel and aluminum construction
→ Modular design for efficient transport and on-site assembly

THE PROCESS

Using Vectorworks, we created comprehensive technical documentation:
• Elevation and section drawings with exact dimensions
• CNC layout files optimized for routing efficiency
• Material specifications (aluminum panels, MDF substrates)
→ Component labeling and assembly sequencing
• Coordination with truss systems and LED integration

THE RESULT

A stage that didn''t just hold equipment—it became part of the show. The LED arch framed every performance, the modular construction allowed for rapid setup, and the precision fabrication ensured everything fit perfectly on-site.

6,800 fans experienced music history. We made sure the stage was ready.'
WHERE slug = 'red-bull-jukebox';
